description:
The DataFrame subsystem spans three layers totaling 21,643 statements at 50.7%
coverage - the single largest coverage gap in the project.

Layer breakdown:
- DF query implementations: 12,180 stmts at 36.6% (benchmark SQL-to-DF translations)
- DF platform adapters: 5,847 stmts at 67.7% (unified_frame, polars_df, pandas_df, etc.)
- DF core framework: 3,285 stmts at 73.5% (benchmark_suite, data_loader, tuning)
- DF runner: 331 stmts at 50.2% (dataframe_runner.py)

Strategy: test the platform/framework/runner layers properly (~4,500 stmts gain),
test the most-used query sets (TPC-H, SSB, read_primitives), and exclude the
mechanical bulk (TPC-DS 99-query set at 6.9%, datavault at 12.3%) from coverage
scope. All locally testable with Polars + Pandas (both are project dependencies).

anti_patterns.dont: create one giant test fixture for all queries
anti_patterns.instead: use function-scoped fixtures or session-scoped immutable data
anti_patterns.why: shared mutable state causes flaky tests

anti_patterns.dont: mock the DataFrame engine to test query logic
anti_patterns.instead: use real Polars/Pandas with small test data
anti_patterns.why: you're testing mock behavior not real execution

anti_patterns.dont: test DataFrame queries by asserting only `.columns` is truthy
anti_patterns.instead: assert specific column names and types
anti_patterns.why: truthy check passes for any non-empty sequence

anti_patterns.instead: exclude from scope and test framework instead
anti_patterns.why: there are 99 of them and the effort vastly exceeds the value

deferrals.reason: ClickBench uses a single wide table with specific data patterns. Testing requires the ClickBench dataset or representative fixtures. Lower priority - push after main targets are hit.
Already at reasonable coverage. Experimental benchmark type. Cover when AI primitives benchmark stabilizes.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] conditional-unmet: Deferred pending AI-primitives benchmark stabilization; coverage already reasonable (68.3%) and no signal the experimental benchmark has stabilized.

deferrals.reason: Small benchmark with straightforward queries. Already >60%. Low ROI for the effort to build test fixtures.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: Coffeeshop dataframe already >60% covered; reason explicitly notes low ROI for effort, small benchmark, straightforward queries.

deferrals.reason: Table format maintenance (compaction, optimization, vacuum) requires real table format infrastructure. Better covered by the platform-live-integration-tests TODO.

preserves.behavior: Existing DataFrame tests must continue to pass - new tests are additive
Polars and Pandas must remain the only required test engines - no pyspark/dask in fast tests
Test suite speed: DataFrame tests must stay under fast marker (<1s each)
unified_frame.py public API must not change - tests validate existing interface

Test TPC-H dataframe queries against known results at SF=0.01
Test read_primitives and transaction_primitives dataframe operations
Test pyspark_df and lakesail_df adapter stubs
Test unified_frame.py: column, filter, and sort operations
Test unified_frame.py: aggregation, joins, and window functions
Test unified_frame.py: expression building and error paths
Test DataFrame platform adapters: expression_family + pandas_family + benchmark_mixin
Test datafusion_df.py and polars_df.py adapter operations
Test dataframe_runner.py lifecycle with real engines
Test DF core framework: data_loader, profiling, tuning, context
